colors.name: Pure White
colors.use: Wordmark and one highlight on black

colorScheme.note: White text on Precision Cyan is 3.5:1; use black text on cyan buttons.

pattern.name: Precision Lines
pattern.description: Fine diagonal Precision Cyan lines on Carbon Obsidian.
usage: Use on black panels and box interiors
Do not increase line weight or opacity above 50%

guideline.clearSpace: Keep clear space equal to the cap height of the wordmark on every side. Nothing (text, edges, other logos) enters this zone.
guideline.minimumSize: Digital 90 px wide; print 22 mm wide
do: Use cyan for one structural line or icon set
dont: Do not place the logo on photographs without a solid panel
Do not use cyan for body text on light backgrounds

typography.display: Poppins SemiBold / Bold for headlines and key numbers; Montserrat for subtitles and labels
typography.body: Helvetica Neue for print body copy; Inter on the web; Calibri in Office documents
typography.note: Typefaces follow Brand System section 04. Never retype a wordmark; always place the supplied logo file.
